## 2024-05-15 - [Reverse Tabnabbing in Markdown Viewer]
**Vulnerability:** External links generated by markdown viewer lacked `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, exposing users to Reverse Tabnabbing.
**Learning:** DOMPurify hooks (e.g. `afterSanitizeAttributes`) are global. When used dynamically inside a React component for specific sanitization needs (like enforcing external link attributes), they can cause unintended global side-effects or memory leaks if not removed.
**Prevention:** Always add DOMPurify hooks right before `DOMPurify.sanitize()` and wrap the sanitization call in a `try...finally` block. In the `finally` block, call `DOMPurify.removeHook()` for the hooks you added. Ensure that target attribute logic only targets external links (e.g., checking if `href` starts with `http://` or `https://`) to avoid breaking internal document navigation.
